subject.title: feat: optionally show runtime status after /new and /reset

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose a default-off `commands.showRuntimeStatusOnReset` setting for verbose bare `/new` and `/reset` acknowledgements?
rationale: The implementation preserves existing behavior and has focused proof, but the choice to add a durable public command configuration option is a product and configuration-surface decision that cannot be established from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the opt-in setting
options.body: Approve the new default-off command setting after resolving the branch conflict, keeping compact acknowledgements unchanged for existing configurations.

options.title: Decline the added config surface
options.body: Close the proposal if the extra runtime-status acknowledgement does not justify another permanent `commands.*` option.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in setting
recommendation.body: Approve the new default-off command setting after resolving the branch conflict, keeping compact acknowledgements unchanged for existing configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes the feature discussion to this person, and the remaining question is product acceptance rather than a mechanical patch repair.
